reason: Adds a persistent VS Code-style web terminal panel that runs a configurable interactive shell in a PTY and streams it to the browser; human review is warranted because it enables shell and filesystem operations.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面中提供可配置的交互式 PTY 终端面板，支持 shell 会话、实时输出和终端显示设置。
summaries.en: Adds a configurable interactive PTY terminal panel to the DeepSeek Harness web interface with shell sessions, live output, and terminal display settings.

capabilities: spawns an interactive shell process in a PTY
streams terminal input and output through a WebSocket
allows configuring the shell executable and working directory
loads xterm.js from a CDN for terminal rendering
